source_issue.title: Typing error when using `description` in schema with TextWidget – prop is unused and should be removed

summary_markdown:
## What this issue is about
This issue addresses a typing error related to the `description` property when using the `TextWidget` in the Plone Volto project. Specifically, the `description` is passed as a prop but isn't utilized correctly, leading to potential confusion.

## What needs to be done
The likely solution is to revise the type declaration of `description` in `TextWidget` to accept React elements (`PropTypes.node`). This modification allows for consistent handling of the `description` prop.

## Helpful background
To reproduce the issue, you can add a React element as the `description` in the `Teaser/schema.js`, save the file as `.jsx`, and check the browser console for typing errors. Discussions around the issue have revealed different views on the best approach, so clarity on implementation might still be needed.

## Good first steps
1. Review the code in `TextWidget` and `FormFieldWrapper` to understand how `description` is currently implemented.
2. Update the `TextWidget` to accept a wider range of prop types for `description`.
3. Test your changes to ensure the typing error no longer appears.
4. Consider contributing a pull request to this issue, but be aware of existing discussions and proposals. Follow up with the community if you have questions!
